anchors.description: Upright white paper-towel roll standing on the floor at the left front of the dark nightstand; height measured on its front face from the top rim to the base.
anchors.visible_evidence: White cylinder about 23 px wide and 45 px tall (height/width ratio ~2.0) at approx. (449-472, 196-242), with a visible elliptical top face, standing against the dark nightstand; proportions match a standard 11 in tall x ~5.5-6 in diameter paper-towel roll.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: A white bottle/thermos of similar size cannot be fully excluded, but the 2:1 height-to-diameter ratio and paper-white surface favor a jumbo paper-towel roll; height uncertainty about +/-3 cm.

anchors.description: Pale-blue upright hardcover book on the third shelf of the bookcase at left-center; measured from its top edge down to the white page block resting on the shelf.
anchors.visible_evidence: Bookcase left of center shows three rows of books; the selected pale-blue spine near (338,120) runs nearly vertically between the dark shelf above (~y=97) and its white page block on the shelf below (~y=136-139), spanning almost the full row gap.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Generic domestic hardcover/textbook of unknown title and edition; the shelf holds mixed sizes and some books lean, so the chosen spine could be a somewhat shorter or taller volume; prior 21-31 cm.
